description:
Update developer-facing docs for the scenario-based coverage workflow after the refactor lands. Explain how scenarios are authored, how fixture names are preserved, how mix req_llm.model_compat maps --scenario and --capability to scenario modules, and when live recording is or is not required.

Include guidance that broad coverage remains replay-first and that sparse live provider drift checks should be added separately rather than expanding routine replay suites into live CI.

Candidate docs:
- AGENTS.md testing section
- test/AGENTS.md
- guides/fixture-testing.md
- guides/mix-tasks.md, if command behavior changes

Proof target: docs-only review plus existing tests from earlier tasks.
title: Document scenario workflow and live verifier policy
